Marta Silva: Quick sync 1h before final freeze. Marketplace launch next Fri 09:00 UTC. Need final checks: press embargo, marketplace SKUs, HW partner badge, SI quickstarts. Any red flags?

Owen Reed: AWS listing needs final SKU + metering names. I can push the SKU if product confirms price tiers by EOD.

Priya Shah: Marketing: press draft due Wed noon. Partner PRs want embargo copy 48h prior. Also need two short customer quotes for the hero.

Tom Becker: HW partner (VertexLab) sent logos but brand requires "validated on VertexLab" wording until certification. Legal asked we avoid "certified".

Marta Silva: Ok change copy to "validated on VertexLab hardware". Priya, add partner spotlight module instead of a co-authored blog for launch.

pm-bot: Reminder: publish-runbook -> /runbooks/marketplace-publish.md. Migration window Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Owen Reed: SI docs: quickstart snippets added to Confluence. Need a terraform + helm example for the landing deploy tab. I'll paste the helm snippet into the doc today.

Priya Shah: Action items: 1) finalize press draft Wed noon. 2) Add partner spotlight module. 3) Replace wording to "validated on VertexLab hardware".

Tom Becker: I'll chase VertexLab legal for logo approval. If delayed we'll use placeholder badge and update post-launch.

Marta Silva: Analytics: product needs event names for purchase_complete and subscription_upgrade by Thu noon. Owen, can you send mapping?

Owen Reed: Yep will send mapping to analytics today.

Priya Shah: One more: confirm support contact on marketplace listing. Use support@redwood.com unless partners request otherwise.

Marta Silva: Great. Quick go/no-go check Fri 06:00 UTC. If anything critical pops up flag here. :rocket:
